tasks.title: Add rate limiting to public API
tasks.objective: Add per-key rate limiting to the public API so one client can't starve the others. Over the limit, return 429 with a Retry-After header.
tasks.status: Per-key rate limiting is live on the public API. Over the limit, clients get a 429 with a Retry-After header. The default is 120 requests a minute; /search has its own limit of 60. 15 tests cover it.

messages.body: Add per-key rate limiting to the public API so one client can't starve the others. Over the limit, return 429 with a Retry-After header.

Tests pass — 14 new ones cover the limit, the 429 response and the Retry-After header.

One decision before I finish: **/search** is much heavier than the other endpoints. Should it get a tighter limit of 60 a minute, or share the default 120?

toolEvents.text: The API already uses DRF, so I'll use its throttling rather than adding middleware.

tasks.status: Deliveries retry up to five times with backoff.

messages.body: Retry failed webhook deliveries with exponential backoff, and honour the Retry-After header when a receiver sends one.
